publisher: Devon County Council / Devon & Dartmoor Historic Environment Record
evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public MapServer layer 669 is named Listed buildings, has geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, supports GeoJSON, and exposes ListEntry, Name, Grade, NGR, CaptureScale, NHLE_URL and Shape fields. Its metadata says the dataset is maintained and amended by the Devon County Council Historic Environment Record based on Historic England data and notes that central Exeter records are out of date. A distinct first-50 spatial window over Topsham/outer Exeter (BNG envelope 294000,87000,299500,91500) was attempted, but the query payload was inaccessible before any feature geometry or attributes could be read.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer metadata declares esriGeometryPolygon and a Shape field; the selected bbox query payload was blocked before any record geometry could be read, so no footprint was accepted.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer metadata exposes a Name field, but no record payload was retrieved; no building type/use value was inferred or accepted.
field_evidence.heritage: Official layer metadata exposes ListEntry, Grade and NHLE_URL fields and states the layer is maintained by the Devon County Council HER from Historic England data.
